steps.content: It takes you a few minutes to find a vehicle, and another good amount of time to fight through the horde of enemies. By the time your pursuit finally starts, the car has already built a considerable lead.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm sorry, Chief. Nightmare can't match their speed.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But I can break their car with my power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, Hecate. That would hurt the civilians.
After giving Hecate a reassuring smile, you find Max King's contact number that the agents just sent over and dial it in a fury.

steps.speaker: Refined Aged Voice
steps.content: Hello, this is the Max King Campaign Office.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: And this is the MBCC Chief! Stop the car!

steps.speaker: Refined Aged Voice
steps.content: Oh, Chief. Hi, I'm Mr. King's assistant. My apologies, but I'm currently driving. He has been eager to have a chat with you. Please hold the line.

steps.speaker: Refined Aged Voice
steps.content: Sir, it's the MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Oh—coming! One sec!
After a brief commotion of shuffling and fumbling, an overly booming voice finally comes through the terminal.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I know they were no match for you, Chief ${PlayerName}! No worries, the ladies are in good hands. They've got my King's limousine here, plenty o' room, bulletproof and 100% green!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Even better, I have a top-notch driver who can shake off any pursuers in no time. You can rest assured without any doubt!
He can barely contain the excitement in his tone, clearly pleased with the present circumstances, which only fuels your rage even further.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pull over immediately! Captain Eugene, intercept them!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Copy that! Team A, move in!
Above the streets, a helicopter thunders by, chasing the vehicle below. Three minutes later—

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, they've gone round us! Target vehicle has turned into a narrow alley!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What??? Wasn't that supposed to be a stretched limo? How did it fit into an alley?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Phew... My sincerest apologies, Chief, we just got a run-in with some unknown hostiles trying to intercept us. Thankfully, Adrian here is an exceptional driver and managed to slip away in time.

steps.speaker: Refined Aged Voice
steps.content: As a former FAC soldier, I do know a thing or two about driving.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: The team descends along the stairs, venturing deeper into the darkness.

steps.speaker: Adrian
steps.content: He will. He has placed a listening device on you. He can hear everything.
steps.female_content: She will. She has placed a listening device on you. She can hear everything.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Whoa, brilliant! That's just what I'd expect from him!
steps.female_content: Whoa, brilliant! That's just what I'd expect from her!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, are they bad people?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Nah, just a smart arse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mr. King, I was the one who's intercepting you. Are you aware that your actions could be considered kidnapping and hostage-taking?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Kidnapping?! Good heavens, what a huge misunderstanding! I'm here to rescue them—by your words, no less!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: You told me to get them away from danger, don't you remember?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Now I want you to pull over.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Yeah I know, I'd love to meet you too! But uh... there are monsters hot on our heels. Too risky to stop now! And that Mania contamination—surely can't let them draw near the kid, right?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Eh... Here's an idea, Chief: you take care of our pursuers, and I'll turn right back around to meet you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That won't work. Stop the car first, then I'll deal with your pursuers.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: If I stop now, those monsters will be breathing down my neck in no time! Chief, you’re the best in DisCity at handling them—show them how it’s done!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nice try. What if you run away while I'm fighting?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Run away? Never gonna! The only running I'm interested in is straight to you! I've been eager to meet you for ages—your backing in the election would mean everything to me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who gives a **** about your election!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Ah, that sounds like something Hella would say.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Ooh... now that's authentic Syndicate slang! Just what I'd expect from the great hero of the West District—talking like a true local!
Right now, you keenly feel the absence of Hella and her legendary sharp tongue, if only she were here to verbally dismantle this guy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is your final warning. If you really want to make acquaintance with me, then right now, STOP—

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Sir!
Before your words could be finished, an unusual tremor shakes the ground. A deafening roar echoes through the communication line, cutting off the voice on the other end abruptly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What happened?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey!! Can you hear me?!
You instinctively slam down on the gas, desperate to catch up.
You're almost there—it won't take long before you meet them. However, when you lay eyes on King's limousine, the sight before you is utterly horrifying.
A humanoid creature has torn open the car's roof and is peering inside like a ghoul lifting the lid of a coffin. Only when it catches sight of your approach does it straighten up.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Is that... our reinforcement?

Her clothing is charred by flames, the red glow unveiling a metallic body beneath. She is not from the Underground, not a Puppet—you can't discern what she truly is, but her hostile stance makes one thing clear...
As your attention is fixed on the imminent threat ahead, you abruptly perceive the stealthy approach of another presence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who's there?!

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: We are not enemies, Chief. I am Adrian Vale, Mr. King's butler.

steps.speaker: Adrian Vale
steps.content: I sincerely apologize for the trouble we've caused, but please understand that it wasn't intentional.
The elderly man standing before you exudes a gentle demeanor, and the person he has been carrying on his back is none other than Max King, the Speaker candidate himself.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Cough... Wait, those two are still...
Mr. King has fallen unusually quiet. His first exposure to a Mania battlefield has taken a heavy toll on his mind, leaving him uttering incomprehensible words in a daze.

The elderly man gazes with tender concern at his semi-conscious master, then offers you an apologetic look. Despite his gray hair and apparent age of at least sixty, he seems completely unaffected by the Mania contamination in the area.

steps.speaker: Adrian Vale
steps.content: That model... Despite being a decade old, its performance remains outstanding, even by today's standards.

steps.speaker: Adrian Vale
steps.content: She used to be an FAC combat unit. I came across several of them during my years of service—this model, in particular, is quite tough to deal with.
FAC is involved in this? The gravity of the situation may be beyond your imagination.
...However, this isn't the time for such thoughts. You turn your attention back to the cyborg soldier and the vehicle hijacked by her.
Behind you, the pursuing Underground Puppets have caught up, now also set on claiming the intercepted luxury car.
